items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Irvin Joseph on drum. Irvin, that's my cousin.

ctx.x: When do you think, how long you started there in 1921 or so maybe then? I guess so around the 20s, yeah. When was Bunk in it then, when you joined?

Not when I first joined, but after I was in there, well, I got him. You don't know just 20 joined then? No, I don't know when. I used to go to New Orleans and get substitutes, you know, with plays, just like I did in the Black Eagle. Black Eagle, I went and got Earl Humphrey and John Joseph, Irvin Joseph on drum. Irvin, that's my cousin. Yeah, Tom Benton.
Oh, he had banjo or guitarist. Yeah, well, I got reinforced those country bands. I was bunking the Black Eagle band too for a while. Yeah, uh-huh. With you, same time as you? No, not same time.
